title: Georgia National Guard Wildfire Suppression Operations (POV)
description: U.S. Army Soldiers with the 78th Aviation Troop Command, Georgia Army National Guard support wildfire suppression efforts with partner agencies in a CH-47 Chinook helicopter in Pineland, Georgia, Apr. 25, 2026. The Georgia Department of Defense plays an integral role in declared emergencies by providing a versatile and ready force capable of responding to natural and manmade disasters across the United States. (U.S. Army National Guard video courtesy of 78th Aviation Troop Command; Edited by Pfc. Emerson Sneary)
